title: Evertrail Idle - Free MMO Idle Game
author: Slapbox98
selftext:
Hello everyone!

For a few months I have been daily working on a melvor/runescape like feel Idle game. Fully free to play, 0 pay to win. Made for people who don't always have 10 hours a day to grind a game but like the idle aspect and still see visual and meaningful progress while also participating in social events for a true like MMO feel while idling.

What I did and want to do different is focusing more on the visual part of Idle games, I am really going my own direction with this cause it feels more like an MMO rather then just another full on click in a browser type of game.

So far we have over 1000 account creations, a lovely starting little community and dedicated players. We are currently in a open alpha and I am looking for feedback/suggestions.

What we currently have:

* 18 Fully working skills
* 3D worlds, chat system, party system, leaderboards, player run market and world events
* Ironman/normal gamemodes
* Meaningful gear progression
* And many many many more things

1 Full big wipe is planned for when Steam early access launches.

**AI Disclosure:** because I know a lot of you care and I'd rather just say it: I use AI tools a lot. Most of the code is written with Claude, and a fair amount of the 3D art was made with AI tools too. The goal is not to make millions through an AI game, but rather to create something that players can and will enjoy for a long time.

I would really love some feedback! And enjoy the little gameplay trailer attached :)

Desktop/Mobile compatible.

Play: [https://play.evertrailidle.com/](https://play.evertrailidle.com/)

Discord: [https://discord.gg/9P82zm3bdK](https://discord.gg/9P82zm3bdK)
